responsibility: Implements the RISC-V vectorization cost model used by GCC’s tree vectorizers for RVV. It extends `vector_costs` with RVV-specific statement costing, loop-level adjustments, VLA-versus-VLS heuristics, memory-reference accounting, and a local live-range analysis that estimates vector register pressure to guide dynamic LMUL selection and detect likely spills, thereby influencing whether and how loops and SLP expressions are vectorized for the RISC-V vector extension.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the riscv-vector-costs pair: it defines the RVV cost-model behavior, including statement-cost adjustment, VLA/VLS heuristics, memory-reference accounting, and live-range based spill analysis, whereas the header only declares the costs class and its supporting types.
